en:
Wow! The trial is racing toward its thrilling
conclusion! Do you know who the culprit is?

Obviously, I know.
Cuz I know everything.

Daddy knows everything about anything.
He basically traded his bearhood for godhood.

Traded? No, I'm still obviously a bear.
It is obvious, right? Right, you guys?

Ya sure ain't no fish!
But ya damn sure smell like one!

Anyway, since I know everything,
I'll give you the whole story later.

Try your hardest to nab the culprit.
And believe me, that's no lie.

If I lied, it would shake the game
to its very foundation.

So trust me and please enjoy the
class trial without any worries.

I feel like we're getting close to the gory
part... It's making me nervous...

I dunno who the culprit is! But I'm not
paying attention, so it's okay!
Yeah, but there's one thing we do know.

The line between victim and attacker
ain't as clear as you might think.

...I suppose that's one lesson we
can take away from this case.

I cut off the leg before the poison spread!
By spring, flowers'll grow from the stump!
